label: Camoufox (stealth Firefox)
requirements: uv (pinned 0.13.5): an explicit UV/UV_BIN or a working uv on PATH is used, otherwise the pinned release is downloaded into the plugin data directory and SHA-256 verified
Plugin-managed CPython 3.13.17 (installed by uv under the plugin data directory; UV_PYTHON or PYTHON override)
camoufox-playwright-mcp==0.1.5 (installed into <plugin data>/venvs/camoufox on first start; CAMOUFOX_MCP_PACKAGE override)
Camoufox build v156.0.1-beta.39 (one-time ~1.3 GB download, ~2.4 GB on disk)

toolSupportNotes.browser_annotate: Not implemented by camoufox-playwright-mcp 0.1.5; it omits the upstream Node dashboard daemon.
toolSupportNotes.browser_emulate_media: Not implemented by camoufox-playwright-mcp 0.1.5; absent from its tool registry.
toolSupportNotes.browser_start_recording: Not implemented by camoufox-playwright-mcp 0.1.5; absent from its tool registry.
toolSupportNotes.browser_stop_recording: Not implemented by camoufox-playwright-mcp 0.1.5; absent from its tool registry.
toolSupportNotes.browser_pdf_save: Listed by the backend but unusable on Firefox: PDF output is only supported by headless Chromium.
toolSupportNotes.browser_run_code_unsafe: Executes asynchronous Python Playwright code, not JavaScript; a prompt written for the JS tool will fail.

notes: Stealth Firefox via camoufox-playwright-mcp 0.1.5. 68 of the 72 canonical browser tools; portable by default. Needs no system Python or uv: the launcher provisions a pinned uv, a managed Python and a venv under the plugin data directory on first start. No CDP.
